name: Slate Roof
description: Natural slate tiles — very durable (75–150 yr lifespan) but heavy and expensive to repair.

name: Copper Plumbing
description: Durable copper supply pipes; antimicrobial and long-lived. Watch for pinhole leaks in acidic-water areas.

name: Off-Street Parking
description: Parking on the property but not in a garage — driveway or pad.

name: Lead Paint
description: Pre-1978 homes likely have lead paint. Requires EPA-certified contractor for disturbing painted surfaces.
